## Description

**What**: Build the human-labeled calibration corpus at plugins/dso/data/visual-eval-corpus/ with ≥40 balanced examples (≥10 per attribution_class) and compute inter-rater Cohen's kappa.

**Why**: The calibration script needs trustworthy ground truth to gate agent quality. Synthetic or heuristic-derived labels are explicitly excluded.

**Scope**:
- IN: ≥40 fixtures conforming to schema {screenshot.png, design_manifest.json, expected: {attribution_class, attribution_confidence, scores}, labeler_id, labeled_at}
- IN: ≥2 labelers per fixture for kappa computation
- IN: Heuristic labels marked provenance:heuristic and excluded from gate computation
- OUT: Calibration script logic (draft-3b)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, corpus at plugins/dso/data/visual-eval-corpus/ contains ≥40 fixtures with ≥10 per attribution_class conforming to the struct schema
  <- Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, heuristic-labeled examples marked provenance:heuristic and excluded from gate computation
  <- Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, ≥2 labelers per fixture; Cohen's kappa computed and recorded in corpus metadata
  <- Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Operational] Requires ≥2 human labelers; identify and recruit before story start. If only 1 labeler available, story is blocked — emit visual_eval_inapplicable:calibration_labelers_missing

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
